name: Selfish
overview: Scripture warns against selfishness by urging believers to turn their hearts away from covetousness and to value others above themselves, as seen in Psalms 119:36 and Romans 12:3, 10. The call to support the weak and to give generously reflects Christ's teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive (Acts 20:35). Selfish ambitions and contentiousness lead to unrighteousness and divine judgment, highlighting the need for humility and brotherly love rather than self-centeredness (Romans 2:8, 12:10).
